title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. Activities and the objective include Provide targeted households with awareness raising and partial subsidies for Index Based Livestock Insurance, support people affected by acute crisis with livelihood recovery package based on their preferences e.g. drought resistance and short maturing vegetable and crop seed, Support climate sensitive livelihood diversification and develop emergency prevention and preparedness measures including insurance schemes to cope with potential climatic disasters. So, individuals and communities can protect, revitalise and restore their livelihoods. Programmes are in partnership with Sodo Catholic Secretariat, Adigrat Diocesan Catholic Secretariat – Mekelle and Daughter of Charity-Tigray.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 4.2Women and men in communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief assistance towards meeting their food and livelihoods needs. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this objective is:- Promote sustainable, resilient approaches to agriculture i.e. the adoption of agroecological practices- Management of natural resources to protect local biodiversity- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- reduce poverty at a household level for the most marginalised of a community- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boysCapacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach
